question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word: **

He took the **current **route to avoid delays.

options.text: The current was unusually strong near the bridge.
The report discussed current economic policies.
She adapted to current fashion quickly.
He read current events before the exam.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"current"** in the sentence means something belonging to the present time or happening now. (वर्तमान / मौजूदा)

 
 
• **Example:** She is aware of the current situation in the country.
 
 
 
• The word **"current"** in **Option 1** refers to the flow of water in a river or sea. (जलधारा / पानी का बहाव)
 
 
• **Example:** The swimmer struggled against the strong current of the river.
 
 
 
• Both words have the same spelling and pronunciation but different meanings, which makes them **homonyms**.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** **Current** refers to something happening now or at the present time. (वर्तमान)

 
 
• **Example:** The report focuses on current economic challenges.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** **Current** refers to the present or modern trend. (वर्तमान / प्रचलित)
 
 
• **Example:** She keeps up with current fashion trends.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** **Current** refers to recent or present events. (वर्तमान घटनाएँ)
 
 
• **Example:** Students should stay informed about current affairs.
 
 

42:Tbf2,
The correct answer is **Option 3:** <
